annotation: Manual review of native top-right crops and scene thumbnails; count is visible lit symbols, null is unreadable/non-game. Per-frame blue tint does not establish flashing. Source-clock boundaries are sampled, not detector-generated. A second manual readability pass marks clipped or featureless positions and non-game screens null independently of reader predictions. stars_present describes the reviewed positive/negative sequence, not a claim that hidden pixels establish absence.
